name: Google Search Console
description: Google Search Console reports how Google Search discovers, crawls, indexes, and presents website properties in search results.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Google account through Relay-owned OAuth with only webmasters.readonly and bind one URL-prefix or sc-domain property. Six semantic wrappers list up to twenty-five accessible properties, confirm selected-property access, query at most twenty-eight days and twenty-five Search Analytics rows, inspect one contained URL, list up to twenty-five sitemaps, or read one contained sitemap. Relay blocks property and sitemap writes, broad exports, raw tools, service accounts, delegation, and automatic pagination.

capabilities.description: Read up to twenty-five rows over no more than twenty-eight days.

capabilities.description: Read safe index, canonical, mobile, and rich-result status for one contained URL.

capabilities.label: List sitemaps
capabilities.description: List up to twenty-five sitemap status records.

capabilities.label: Read sitemap
capabilities.description: Read one contained sitemap status record.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must enable the Search Console API, configure its confidential Google web client, verify the exact webmasters.readonly consent scope, configure Railway staging credentials, and authorize an acceptance account with a Search Console property. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback and exact read-only scope, complete Google review, configure staging credentials, then verify property binding, all six reads, containment, bounds, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, and quota/error mapping.

evidence.supports: Google documents the bounded sites.list discovery endpoint and read-only authorization scope.
Google documents the property-bound Search Analytics POST endpoint, dimensions, search and aggregation types, rows, and offset pagination Relay does not follow.
Google documents URL Inspection as a read-only POST requiring an inspection URL under the selected site property.
Google documents property-bound sitemap listing and the webmasters.readonly scope.
